verdict.rationale: First-party install docs show Crossplane runs in your own Kubernetes cluster via a public Helm chart (`helm install crossplane --namespace crossplane-system ... crossplane-stable/crossplane`). The docs also cover install-time flags, feature flags and pre-release channels, so the core control plane is clearly self-hostable. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted installs, explicit evidence of the open-source license backing the openness claim.
